DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Used when deploying the Dockerfile bootstrap image from this folder. Marketplace image: create the first admin via Sign up instead.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for Dockerfile bootstrap deploys. Auto-generated; save from Variables after deploy.

DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: Dockerfile bootstrap only: close open registration after admin creation.

DATABASUS_URL.description: Public base URL used in email links. Generate a Railway domain first.

PORT.description: HTTP listen port. Keep 4005 for Databasus.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Railway Bucket S3 endpoint. Paste into Databasus → Storages → S3.

S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket name for backup archives.
